item.title: Refresh of Councillor Handbook on Libraries
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 8,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-09T17:00:00Z
The context in which libraries operate has moved on since our Councillor handbook was first published in 2017. The planned refresh of the publication aims to provide councillors – primarily those with portfolio responsibility for library services – with a guide that outlines the key statutory requirements for delivering the service, opportunities to design and prepare the service for future changes, and options for maximising the service’s impact for local residents. This will include case studies of interesting and effective practice. Where relevant, sections of the existing handbook may be retained and incorporated into the refreshed guide. Your Quotation should give an indicative and high level outline of where you think change is required, and what could be usefully retained. The guide aims to support practical advocacy for library services, providing prompts or key questions to help readers assemble evidence and make the case for their services. Suppliers should propose the most useful format to do this in their submission. The guide should aim to support councillors to make connections with policy objectives across a range of council outcomes, including neighbourhood health, early years and skills, economic growth in every postcode, and high street regeneration. The guide will not be expected to deal with all of these in depth but can signpost to existing information where it exists,
